use_case: Skin-image analysis device software function: flags possible stage 1 and deep tissue pressure injuries in photos nurses take of at-risk skin, with a heat map, as an adjunct to the standard skin assessment
vendor_or_model: In-house image classification model (locked) fine-tuned from an open-source pretrained vision model; runs in the CCC
data_categories: Skin images, body site, and patient identifiers (PHI held for hospitals); outputs: flag, heat map, confidence
human_in_the_loop: A nurse reviews every image and performs the standard skin assessment; the tool never charts, orders, or escalates on its own; 'no flag' does not replace the assessment
applicable_laws: FD&C Act device requirements (De Novo granted 2025-10 with an authorized PCCP); section 524B (N31-33-R05); 21 CFR 803, 806, 820; HIPAA for production PHI (N62-R01); FTC Act Section 5 for performance claims; 45 CFR 92.210 applies to hospital deployers, supported by company subgroup data; Colorado SB26-189 carve-out for FDA-regulated devices
status: In production (22 hospitals since 2026-01); postmarket subgroup condition added

use_case: Alarm artifact reduction model for VM-7: classifies SpO2 and ECG alarm events as likely artifact and may delay the secondary notification to clinicians' phones by up to 15 seconds; the bedside alarm is never delayed or silenced
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted and neural models trained on 1.9 million annotated alarm events from 9 hospitals (de-identified)
data_categories: De-identified waveforms and alarm events (training); live waveforms and alarm events (production, PHI)
human_in_the_loop: Primary bedside alarms unaffected by design; delayed notifications are logged and visible; clinicians can turn the feature off per unit
applicable_laws: FD&C Act device requirements (510(k) planned 2027 Q2); section 524B (N31-33-R05); 21 CFR 820.10(c) design controls; FDA draft AI-enabled device software function guidance (2025-01-07 notice; nonbinding draft); HIPAA for production data

use_case: Automated optical inspection on Line 1: machine vision model flags solder and placement defects on printed circuit boards
vendor_or_model: AOI equipment vendor's model, fine-tuned on company board images by the vendor
human_in_the_loop: Operators review every flagged board; functional board test and final device test follow; model updates only after validation
applicable_laws: 21 CFR 820.10(a) and ISO 13485 clause 7.5.6 (validation of production software)
status: In production since 2024; model update validation condition added

use_case: Enterprise generative AI coding assistant for firmware, CCC, and test engineers
vendor_or_model: Enterprise coding assistant (large language model) under a contract with no training on company data and 30-day retention
data_categories: Source code and comments (Confidential); no PHI, keys, or embargoed vulnerability details permitted
consequential_decision_category: None (internal productivity); output enters device software
human_in_the_loop: Every AI-assisted change gets the normal reviewed merge; static analysis and license scanning in CI; not used for cryptographic, signing, or key-handling code
applicable_laws: Section 524B(b)(2) processes and SBOM accuracy (N31-33-R05); 21 CFR 820.10(c) (design controls apply to the resulting code); trade secret protection

use_case: eQMS complaint summarization: generative AI feature summarizes each complaint and suggests whether it may be MDR-reportable
vendor_or_model: eQMS vendor's built-in generative AI feature (model provider carved out of the vendor's SOC 2)
data_categories: Complaint text, sometimes with patient identifiers; device and event details
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: reporting of device safety events)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; supports regulatory safety reporting
human_in_the_loop: Complaint handlers and the Regulatory Affairs Manager make every MDR decision; condition: the suggestion is hidden until the handler records an independent decision
applicable_laws: 21 CFR 803.50 and 803.53 (decisions stay with people); 21 CFR 820.10(a) and ISO 13485 clause 4.1.6 (QMS software validation); HIPAA minimum necessary for PHI in complaints
status: In production since 2026-05-04 without review; validation or switch-off due 2026-11-30
